notes.title: Saltsea Chronicles 1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This small patch contains various minor improvements and fixes to issues, some of which were reported by players. Thanks to all who have helped us to spot and diagnose issues, and we hope you're enjoying your time with Saltsea Chronicles!

[list]
[*] Fixed an audio bug which prevented music from playing
[*] Fixed an audio bugs which led to several overlapping music tracks playing at once
[*] Fixed several bugs in the card game which may have previously blocked some players from playing Spoils 
[*] Altered Spoils slightly: removed the hoarding and bidding rules from the early chapters, where those rules haven’t been introduced by tutorials yet
[*] Fixed bug related to scrolling after interrupted lines in a conversation
[*] Pressing the cancel button while in a conversation now also moves the conversation forward
[*] Fixed a problem with Crew Issues and Crew Issue resolution conversations
[*] Added a visible version number in the Main Menu
[*] Replaced save icon graphic
[*] Other minor bug fixes and polish
[/list]

notes.title: Saltsea Chronicles Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224895/ba52504420223192bf1479c1f15c19195bccd74a.png[/img]

We're delighted to announce [url=https://www.saltseachronicles.com/][i]Saltsea Chronicles[/i][/url] comes out on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10007906]PlayStation 5[/url], Nintendo Switch & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419620/Saltsea_Chronicles/]PC/Mac[/url] (including Steam Deck) on... 12th October, 2023!

We're so proud of all of the wonderful folks who worked with us on the game and careful, thoughtful and excellent contributions they all made. [url=https://www.saltseachronicles.com/][i]Saltsea Chronicles[/i][/url] is a carefully radical vision of a future world where you play as a whole crew - exploring with the community rather than as a hero, in a story rich with possibilities, and a world full of intrigue and delight. 

We've released a brand new trailer to celebrate, watch it now below, and wishlist the game on Steam so you won't miss it!

[previewyoutube=H0jkp8JzXVg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About Saltsea Chronicles[/h2]

Set in a post-flood world, [url=https://www.saltseachronicles.com/]Saltsea Chronicles[/url] allows you to guide a crew of misfits in search of their missing captain. The investigation and the decisions you make will see you explore a series of beautiful and intriguing islands, meet different communities, and see the lives of people built on the ruins of what came before – all as you unravel the mystery at the heart of the game.

[i][url=https://www.saltseachronicles.com/]Saltsea Chronicles[/url] - coming 12th October, 2023 to [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10007906]PlayStation 5[/url], Nintendo Switch & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419620/Saltsea_Chronicles/]PC/Mac[/url] (including Steam Deck).[/i]
